details.description: Llama 2 7B Chat is the smallest dialogue-tuned model in Meta's original Llama 2 family, fine-tuned from the 7B pretrained checkpoint using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and released July 18, 2023. Meta's model card states Llama-2-Chat models "outperform open-source chat models on most benchmarks" tested and are intended for commercial and research use in English. Meta's Llama 3 model card reports this model scoring well below Llama 3 8B Instruct on every listed benchmark, making it an earlier, superseded generation.
advantages: Meta's model card reports this model scores 57.04% on TruthfulQA (percentage of generations that are both truthful and informative, higher is better) and 0.00% on the ToxiGen toxic-generation rate (lower is better).
Meta states Llama-2-Chat models "outperform open-source chat models on most benchmarks" tested, per the model card.
In Meta's human evaluations for helpfulness and safety, Llama-2-Chat models are reported on par with some popular closed-source models like ChatGPT and PaLM, per the model card.
disadvantages: Meta's model card states Llama 2 is intended for commercial and research use in English only and was tested only in English.
Knowledge cutoff of September 2022 for pretraining data, per Meta's model card.
Meta's model card does not describe tool-calling, function-calling or vision support, unlike Meta's later Llama 3.1, 3.2 and 3.3 releases.
Smallest size in the Llama 2 family; Meta's Llama 3 model card comparison table reports the 70B chat variant scoring higher on every listed benchmark (e.g. MMLU 52.9 vs. 34.1).
Superseded by Meta's Llama 3, 3.1, 3.2, 3.3 and 4 model families.
use_cases: General-purpose assistant-like chat, per Meta's stated intended use for tuned Llama 2 models.
Commercial and research natural-language applications in English, per Meta's model card.

sources.title: Llama 2: open source, free for research and commercial use

notes: MMLU/GPQA/HumanEval/GSM-8K/MATH scores for this exact chat model come from Meta's Llama 3 model card's side-by-side comparison table (labeled 'Llama 2 7B' under Instruction tuned models), not the Llama 2 card itself, which reports only TruthfulQA/Toxigen for Llama-2-Chat. Catalog's 4,096-token max_input/max_output matches Meta's model card and Fireworks' hosted page (4.09k) for this model. Release date (July 18, 2023) is not stated on the Llama 2 model card itself; confirmed on Meta's launch blog post. The tool-calling/vision comparison to later releases is confirmed on the Llama 3.1 and Llama 3.2 model cards, not the Llama 2 or Llama 3 cards.
